trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Unlock all other trophies in the game to claim this ultimate Leonida platinum. It requires completing every story mission, side activity, and collectible across the state. Expect a lengthy journey to achieve 100% completion.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the early story mission 'Gone Fishing' during Chapter 1. This narrative objective unlocks naturally as you progress through the main plot and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish all required story missions making up Chapter 1 of the campaign. It unlocks automatically as part of the primary storyline progression.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Progress through the main campaign until you finish Chapter 2. This milestone story mission triggers automatically during normal playthrough.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete all story assignments in Chapter 3 of the main plot. It is unmissable and unlocks upon finishing the chapter's final required task.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Advance the storyline to the conclusion of Chapter 4. This achievement is unlocked automatically upon completing the final mission of this chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Reach the climax of the main storyline and finish the final narrative mission. It unlocks automatically once the credits roll.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play through the story mission titled 'Breakfast Run' early in the game. It is unmissable and completes as part of standard campaign progression.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Execute 'The Cartel Heist' story mission during the campaign. This major heist objective is unmissable and tied directly to story progression.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the narrative mission 'Child's Play' as part of the campaign arc. It unlocks automatically during normal story progression.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Headliners' when prompted by the campaign. This objective is unmissable and progresses the main plot.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the campaign operation 'VCIA Takedown'. It unlocks automatically as you advance through the mid-game storyline.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Fight through 'Operation Savage Glory' during the later stages of the campaign. This mission is unmissable and tied to main progression.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Complete all side missions, collectibles, and activities across Leonida to reach full completion. Track your progress via the pause menu and tackle remaining tasks in endgame.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Find and successfully execute 250 unique stunt jumps scattered throughout the map. Using a fast sports bike or supercar makes clearing the landing zones much easier.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Participate in every unique recreational activity available across Leonida at least once. Check the map icons for darts, bowling, racing, and shooting range events.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Master all 42 Shooting Range challenges across gun shops and earn gold medals in every single one. Focus on rapid target acquisition and headshots to beat the target scores.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Locate and win the Top Fun drone race event at all 14 distinct map locations. Practice handling tight turns and managing nitro boosts to secure first place.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Place first in 20 distinct street and off-road races across Leonida. Upgrading your vehicle's handling and acceleration beforehand will simplify the grind.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Locate Cal and outperform him in a competitive fishing match by catching the heaviest fish. Use premium bait and manage your reel tension carefully.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find any playable arcade cabinet in bars or safehouses and finish a full game session. Any title available in the arcade will count toward this goal.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play through Andy's stranger strand and finish his concluding narrative mission. It unlocks sequentially as you complete his preceding tasks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's multi-part stranger mission chain by completing his final encounter. Check your map for his marker after advancing the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Progress through Billy's stranger strand until you unlock and complete his final mission. Follow up on his marker locations across the state.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find and finish all missions for 8 different eccentric characters wandering around Leonida. Keep an eye out for question mark icons on your minimap.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's string of side quests and finish his final mission. It becomes available as you progress through the game world.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's character arc by completing his final mission strand. Look for his specific icon to appear on the map as chapters unfold.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Visit and complete a meditation session at all 18 scenic viewpoints across Leonida. These peaceful spots are often located in remote nature reserves and coastal cliffs.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Complete a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track and hunt down a rare legendary animal requested by Bret in the wilderness. Equip a sniper rifle and check wind direction to secure a clean harvest.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Hunt down hidden collectible cards scattered across the game world to finish 3 complete sets. Explore shops, alleys, and residential areas to find them all.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Interact with the WAiNK feature at 100 different map locations across Leonida. Check tourist spots, viewpoints, and urban landmarks to rack up the total.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish any 50 in-game challenges tracked in your profile menu. These include combat feats, driving distances, and weapon milestones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Evade a 4-star police pursuit while partnered up with another character before getting busted. This can be easily missed if you avoid duo encounters, so try it during open-world wandering.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Hold up three stores sequentially with your partner while maintaining active police heat. Plan a fast getaway route between nearby shops to pull this off.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Find and drive 100 distinct vehicle models cruising around Leonida. Keep an eye out for rare sports cars and commercial trucks in traffic.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and eliminate 5 targets before the meter depletes. Make sure to line up headshots quickly in a crowded firefight.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Flee from the VCIA facility abruptly during an operation or visit. Escape the perimeter security to successfully trigger the unlock.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This vague trophy hints at commandeering or surviving in a military Rhino tank under heavy fire. The community is still pinning down the exact trigger requirements, so experiment with military bases.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Infiltrate a jewelry shop and loot the display cases while remaining completely stealthy. Avoid alerting staff or triggering silent alarms to secure the drop.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Crack open 5 bank vaults across the map and successfully lose the cops. Prepare explosives and high-end getaway vehicles before initiating each heist.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Ambush a moving armored cash truck on the highway, breach the doors, and escape the authorities. Sticky bombs work wonders for popping the back doors open.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover all 52 distinct regions on the map by traveling across every road and district in Leonida. Rent a helicopter or fly a plane to easily sweep fog of war.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Locate and raid illicit criminal enterprises operated by all 9 distinct gangs across the map. Scout each location thoroughly before charging in.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head down to Ocean Beach, visit a seaside bar or lounge, and order a cocktail while taking in the ocean view. Relax and enjoy the scenery to trigger the trophy.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal a luxury car from inside a dealership and crash right through the front glass windows to escape. Act fast before local police respond to the alarm.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete a full game of bowling. Aim carefully and time your throw for a strike.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This vague description hints at achieving a top cooperative score or milestone with your partner. The community is still pinning down the exact trigger requirements for this partnership feat.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This trophy hints at completing a major narrative branch or moral decision point. The community is still pinning down the exact trigger conditions across different story paths.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: This cryptic description suggests failing a specific event or mission mechanic twice before succeeding. The community is still pinning down the exact trigger sequence.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: This mysterious trophy likely references an easter egg or bizarre paranormal encounter in the game world. The community is still pinning down the exact trigger spot.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Strike down multiple pedestrians or enemies in rapid succession using a melee weapon while riding past on a bike. Timing and positioning are key.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Funnel illicit cash through your network of contacts until you hit $250,000 in laundered funds. Complete safehouse businesses to maximize cash flow.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Purchase clothing, accessories, and weapons across various stores until your total spending reaches $100,000. Splurging on luxury items speeds this up.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 available garage properties across Leonida to expand your vehicle storage capacity. Save up your cash from major heists to afford them all.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Open up the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone and register 10 different vehicles. Scooters and bikes parked around the city work perfectly.
